title: Step 8 - Check the User's Answer Against the Game Sequence
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: Compare the user's latest click to the pattern and advance the level when the sequence is complete.

concepts.heading: Game rules
points: Game shows first colour; user repeats; then game adds another, user repeats whole sequence; one mistake ends the game.

concepts.heading: checkAnswer(currentLevel)
points: Called from the click handler with userClickedPattern.length - 1, the index of the latest click (4 clicks -> index 3).
Compare gamePattern[currentLevel] === userClickedPattern[currentLevel]; log 'success' or 'wrong' while debugging.
If correct and userClickedPattern.length === gamePattern.length, the user finished the sequence: call nextSequence() after setTimeout 1000 ms.
nextSequence() resets userClickedPattern to [] for the next round.

task.name: Check the answer
task.goal: Game advances when user repeats sequence
steps: If right and lengths match, nextSequence after 1000ms

Forgetting to reset userClickedPattern breaks later levels.
